CRH/Oldcastle.headline: CRH Completes $8.5 Billion Acquisition of Arcosa
CRH/Oldcastle.summary: CRH has closed its approximately $8.5 billion acquisition of Arcosa Inc., significantly expanding its U.S. aggregates network and critical infrastructure materials portfolio.
CRH/Oldcastle.sales_angle: Reach out to CRH integration leadership to offer contract mining, overburden removal, and contract crushing across newly acquired Arcosa aggregate sites.

CRH/Oldcastle.headline: NJ Attorney General requires CRH to divest asphalt plants under settlement
CRH/Oldcastle.summary: The New Jersey Attorney General announced an antitrust settlement requiring the divestiture of specific asphalt plants in New Jersey as part of the proposed CRH-Arcosa transaction. The consent judgment is designed to preserve local market competition and protect public procurement costs.
CRH/Oldcastle.sales_angle: Connect with CRH Northeast asset management and regional leadership as they execute court-mandated divestitures and adjust regional operational footprints.

also_reported_by.publisher: New Jersey Office of Attorney General

CRH/Oldcastle.headline: $8.5B acquisition of Arcosa announced
CRH/Oldcastle.summary: CRH announced an $8.5B acquisition of Arcosa, a major construction-materials and infrastructure products company, expanding CRH's aggregates and infrastructure footprint significantly.

Vulcan Materials.headline: Vulcan Materials Operations Support and Procurement SVP David Clement to Retire
Vulcan Materials.summary: Vulcan Materials disclosed in a regulatory filing that David P. Clement, Senior Vice President of Operations Support and Procurement, plans to retire.
Vulcan Materials.sales_angle: Reach out to Vulcan's operations leadership to maintain contact and introduce outsourced mining services as procurement and operational support leadership transitions.

Vulcan Materials.headline: Vulcan Materials acquires Butler Quarry in Pendleton County, Kentucky
Vulcan Materials.summary: Vulcan Materials has acquired Butler Quarry, a hard rock limestone operation in Pendleton County, Kentucky, from Hilltop Stone. The site has served the Northern Kentucky and Greater Cincinnati construction materials markets for over 70 years.
Vulcan Materials.sales_angle: Reach out to Vulcan's regional leadership to pitch contract mining, pit development, and overburden stripping support during their operational integration of the new site.

Vulcan Materials.headline: CEO transition and Brannan Sand & Gravel acquisition
Vulcan Materials.summary: Vulcan completed a CEO transition and acquired Brannan Sand & Gravel, expanding its Colorado/Texas aggregates footprint as part of a broader western-market growth push.

Amrize.headline: Amrize invests $10.2M to expand Memphis cement distribution terminal
Amrize.summary: Amrize is investing $10.2 million to expand its cement terminal on Presidents Island in Memphis, Tennessee, boosting storage and loading throughput.
Amrize.sales_angle: Touch base with Amrize regional operations to support upstream cement plants and raw material quarries that will feed increased throughput at the Memphis terminal.

Amrize.headline: $900M 2026 capex program; PB Materials and Rapid Redi-Mix acquisitions
Amrize.summary: Amrize is executing a $900M investment program for 2026, including capacity expansion at Ste. Genevieve. Also acquired PB Materials (26 sites, West Texas) and Rapid Redi-Mix (Dallas-Fort Worth).

Rogers Group.headline: Rogers Group pursues rezoning and annexation for 542-acre mine in North Carolina
Rogers Group.summary: The Town of New London scheduled an October 6, 2026 public hearing on Rogers Group requests for voluntary annexation and M-2 heavy manufacturing conditional rezoning. The approvals would enable development of a new aggregate mine across approximately 542 acres in Stanly County.
Rogers Group.sales_angle: Contact Rogers Group greenfield project managers to introduce Turner Mining Group for site development, initial overburden removal, and pioneering services.
Rogers Group.publisher: Town of New London, North Carolina

Rogers Group.headline: Rockydale Quarries acquisition — 13th deal in two years
Rogers Group.summary: Rogers Group acquired Rockydale Quarries, its 13th acquisition in roughly two years, expanding into Virginia and North Carolina.

Titan America.headline: Keystone Cement acquisition closed
Titan America.summary: Titan America closed its acquisition of Keystone Cement (Pennsylvania), expanding its cement production capacity in the Northeast.

Heidelberg Materials.headline: Autonomous haulage expansion to 6 sites
Heidelberg Materials.summary: Heidelberg Materials is expanding its autonomous haulage program (piloted at Lake Bridgeport, TX) to roughly 6 sites and 30 vehicles across its US aggregates operations in 2026.

Quikrete.headline: Quikrete temporarily idles Silverthorne plant due to regional gas pipeline disruption
Quikrete.summary: Quikrete's asphalt and materials plant in Silverthorne, Colorado temporarily halted operations after distant flooding damaged a critical natural gas supply line. The shutdown has temporarily interrupted supply for local paving and infrastructure projects in Summit County.
Quikrete.sales_angle: Check in with regional Colorado operations management on plant restart timing and assess if temporary contract load and haul support will be needed to catch up on production backlogs.

Quikrete.headline: Summit County approves 7-year conditional permit for Quikrete's Silverthorne gravel pit
Quikrete.summary: Summit County commissioners approved a 7-year conditional-use permit for Quikrete's sand and gravel mine and asphalt plant north of Silverthorne, down from the 10-year term previously recommended. The compromise allows continued extraction while the county and operator begin planning for future aggregate sources once this deposit is depleted.
Quikrete.sales_angle: Contact Quikrete's Colorado operations team to discuss contract mining, load-and-haul, and pit optimization services to maximize production efficiency during the approved seven-year window.

Quikrete.headline: Quikrete 10-year permit extension appealed in Summit County, Colorado
Quikrete.summary: Residents of Summit Sky Ranch filed an appeal against a 10-year Conditional Use Permit extension granted to Quikrete by the Lower Blue Planning Commission. The appeal will be heard by the Summit County Board of County Commissioners on October 13, 2026.
Quikrete.sales_angle: Monitor the permit outcome to engage Quikrete's Colorado operations on contracted pit support and compliance needs if operational constraints are imposed.
Quikrete.publisher: Friends Of The Lower Blue River

Quikrete.headline: Missouri DNR issues open-pit limestone permit for Quikrete's Jasper Quarry #15
Quikrete.summary: The Missouri Department of Natural Resources Land Reclamation Program approved an active open-pit limestone mining permit for the 37-acre Jasper Quarry #15 in Barton County, Missouri. The site is operated by Cornejo and Sons dba Midwest Minerals under Quikrete Materials.
Quikrete.sales_angle: Connect with Midwest Minerals and Quikrete operational leads to offer contract overburden removal, drilling, and blasting support under the newly active quarry permit.

Quikrete.headline: $2.8B Martin Marietta asset exchange
Quikrete.summary: Quikrete completed a $2.8B asset exchange with Martin Marietta, receiving the Midlothian, TX cement plant, related terminals, and North Texas ready-mixed concrete assets — the largest deal in Quikrete's history.

CalPortland.headline: Northern California Teamsters strike resolved
CalPortland.summary: Over 350 CalPortland ready-mix drivers across 15 Northern California plants (Sonoma, Marin, Napa, Solano counties) went on strike Aug 6-21, 2026, disrupting public and private construction projects until a new contract was ratified.

Buzzi Unicem.headline: Buzzi subsidiary Alamo Concrete acquires Big Town Concrete in Dallas-Fort Worth
Buzzi Unicem.summary: Buzzi subsidiary Alamo Concrete Products completed the acquisition of Big Town Concrete LLC, adding six ready-mix concrete plants producing 400,000 cubic yards annually to integrate with Buzzi's regional cement distribution network.
Buzzi Unicem.sales_angle: Connect with Buzzi Unicem and Alamo Concrete leadership to explore whether increased downstream ready-mix demand requires increased quarry production or contract overburden stripping at their Texas cement and aggregate operations.

Cemex.headline: Cemex USA acquires new aggregates reserves in Florida
Cemex.summary: Cemex USA finalized an acquisition securing new long-term aggregate reserves to support its vertically integrated operations in the Florida region.
Cemex.sales_angle: Reach out to Cemex USA's Florida operations leadership to offer contract mining, overburden stripping, and site development services for the newly acquired aggregate reserves.

Cemex.headline: Cemex supplies 300,000 cubic yards of concrete for LA Metro D Line extension
Cemex.summary: Cemex supplied more than 300,000 cubic yards of concrete for Section 1 of the Los Angeles Metro D Line Extension transit project.
Cemex.sales_angle: High-volume infrastructure supply commitments in Southern California strain regional aggregate supply; reach out to regional ops to offer contract quarrying and hauling support.

Eagle Materials.headline: Nevada Cement advances EIR for Stockton distribution terminal expansion in California
Eagle Materials.summary: The Port of Stockton held a public meeting on the Draft EIR for Nevada Cement's terminal modernization, which will expand its leased site from 4.92 to 10.98 acres. Upgrades include a new ship unloader, storage dome, and rail and truck loading enhancements.
Eagle Materials.sales_angle: Check in with Nevada Cement management to see if higher terminal distribution capacity will drive increased kiln feed mining and contract quarrying requirements at their production sites.
